properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: The JS test harness uses P-256 to mirror the shipped product's P256.sol and WebAuthn.sol verification features (P256.test.js exercises Wycheproof vectors); the on-chain product uses are reported as findings.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Legacy transitive dependency (2016-era EC library) inside the test toolchain; no app call site found — presence entry. ECDH on secp256k1 is fully Shor-vulnerable; only matters if the toolchain ever uses it for real secrets.
